description.value: Browns Crafthouse is a casual sit-down restaurant and craft beer bar in Fort St. John, part of the BC-based Browns Restaurant Group chain. The Fort St. John location sits in one of Northern BC's larger service centres along the Alaska Highway corridor, making it a natural resupply stop for touring cyclists passing through the Peace River region. The menu spans full food service and an extensive beer selection, with weekend brunch also available.
